# mctl-telegram — Remote MCP Server for Telegram

> `mctl-telegram` is a hosted Remote MCP connector for Telegram. It allows users to securely interact with their Telegram account via ChatGPT (as a custom MCP plugin), Claude.ai, or any MCP client with OAuth 2.1 authentication; new accounts are read-only until the owner opts in to sending.

## Key Resources & Submissions

- [Public Documentation](https://tg.mctl.ai/docs): Getting started and tool documentation.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/mctlhq/mctl-telegram/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Client-facing error families (peer id errors, get_media confirmation errors, session/auth failures, OAuth redirect rules) and what to do about each.
- [Local Bridge](https://tg.mctl.ai/docs/local-bridge): Optional self-hosted session mode. Quick start at `/docs/local-bridge/quickstart`.
- [Security & Trust Model](https://tg.mctl.ai/security): Data minimization and session encryption details.
- [Tool descriptors](https://github.com/mctlhq/mctl-telegram/blob/main/docs/tool-descriptors.json): the generated, authoritative list of every MCP tool with its schema and annotations.

## Tools Summary (37 MCP tools)

The full list with schemas is `docs/tool-descriptors.json`. Highlights:

- `list_dialogs`: Read-only list of dialogs.
- `get_messages` & `get_unread_messages`: Read-only message history and unread items.
- `send_message`, `send_media`, `edit_message`, `delete_messages`, `forward_messages`, `set_reaction`: write tools; sends are previews until the account owner enables `send_enabled` with `set_send_consent`.
- `prepare_pin_message` & `pin_message`: Confirmed pinning with dry-run protection.
- `get_my_audit_log`: Cryptographic tamper-evident hash-chain audit log.
- `disconnect_telegram_account` & `delete_telegram_account`: Account revocation and data deletion.
